title: Chris Kelly, his trombonist, and cousin Pratt's bands and death
summary: He recalls Kelly playing Going Back to Jamaica, his trombonist, low pay of the era, and Pratt dying in 1947.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Chris Kelly, the blues trumpeter and his band
